{{Quote|If Thustra secedes, the entire sector will go along with it.|[[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]|<ref name="yoda" />}}
The '''Sumitra sector''', also called the '''Tierfon sector,''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in Sumitra included [[Thustra/Legends|Thustra]], [[Boordii]], [[Flax]], [[Tierfon/Legends|Tierfon]] and [[Alk'Lellish III]]. The entire [[Sector/Legends|sector]] consisted of 12,387 planets and [[Moon/Legends|moons]].

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the influential planet of Thustra made moves to secede from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Republic forces, under the command of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], attempted to sway the decision of the planet's king, [[Alaric (Sephi)|Alaric]], but to no avail. His subsequent death sent the planet of Thustra, and likely the entire sector as predicted by Supreme Chancellor Palpatine, into the hands of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="yoda" />

The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] had a [[Tierfon Sector Fleet]] stationed in the sector and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] maintained the [[Tierfon Rebel Outpost|Tierfon Rebel Base]] on [[Tierfon/Legends|Tierfon]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The base remained in service into the years that saw the inauguration of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="RASB" /> Following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the Sumitra sector was among the first sectors to throw off the Empire.<ref name="RECG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]'' indicates that Tierfon is in "Tierfon sector"; however, ''Heroes & Rogues'', ''The Star Wars Sourcebook'' and ''Star Wars: Rebellion'' place places Tierfon in Sumitra sector. As such, "Tierfon sector" is here considered a colloquial name for Sumitra sector.

Sumitra sector was one of the many sectors included in [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']], which placed ten planets in the sector; however, ''Rebellion'' made numerous errors in its cartographic placement. As such, when its placements conflict with existing [[canon]] placements, they are overridden.<ref name="Tasty">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=118855&start=15#3897382|thread=Galaxy Map Discussion|user=[[Leland Chee|Tasty Taste]]|date=2003-05-01|time=1:40 PM}}</ref> In the case of the Sumitra sector, that applies to [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], [[Qat Chrystac/Legends|Qat Chrystac]], [[Woostri/Legends|Woostri]] and [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin Prime]]. Kashyyyk is in the [[Mytaranor sector/Legends|Mytaranor sector]], Qat Chrystac is in the [[Parnabe sector/Legends|Parnabe sector]], Woostri is in the [[Woostri sector/Legends|Woostri sector]], and Yavin is in the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]]<ref name="EAOC" />
